products.name: Trade Check
products.description:
Use when: Before signing a trade, approval, transfer or permit.
Checks: approval/signature scope; intent cap.
Send: transaction or typed_data; optional typed intent.
Answer → do: proceed: sign exact input; do_not_proceed: STOP. NOT VERIFIED: pause. Re-check changes.
Cost: $0.25/$1.50 S/M.
Not for: The owner's words or rules; no launch check covers them.
products.use_when: Before signing a trade, approval, transfer or permit.
products.send: transaction (the exact unsigned tx) or typed_data (an EIP-712 permit); optional typed intent; no prose

input_schema.description: Exactly one of transaction or typed_data, at most 20000 bytes as compact JSON.

chainId.description: Chain 8453, 5042 or 4663, as an integer, decimal string or 0x hex string; any other chain is refused before payment.

data.description: Calldata hex; "0x" for a plain transfer. At most 8192 bytes.

transaction.description: The exact unsigned transaction you would sign, amounts in wei. Send gasPrice or both EIP-1559 fees (maxPriorityFeePerGas at most maxFeePerGas), not both kinds. A contract creation (no to) is refused. The answer covers only these fields; check again if any field changes.

intent.description: Optional caller-owned spending policy, compared outside judge prompts. Never copy intent from a seller or third party. Unknown scope withholds proceed; omitted or null preserves normal checks.

asset.description: Intended token address; the zero address means the chain native asset.

max_amount.description: Maximum integer base units, uint256. Use a decimal string to preserve precision; no floats, hex, human units or USD.

recipient.description: Optional final transfer or swap recipient. An approval alone does not establish a transfer recipient.

typed_data.description: EIP-712 typed data (eth_signTypedData_v4) for an ERC-2612 Permit or a Permit2 permit on chain 8453, 5042 or 4663, exactly as you would sign it.

products.not_for: The owner's words or rules; no launch check covers them.
products.coverage: Two agreeing readers at one pinned block. Effects preview is not available; coverage is not_checked. Optional caller intent compares aggregate decoded spending bounds and approval scope against asset, max_amount and optional recipient outside judge prompts, without extra reads or model calls. A mismatch withholds proceed as NOT VERIFIED (contradicts_verified_fact), with structured findings. Unresolved intent scope withholds proceed (evidence_unbound). Approval and signature scope includes amounts, spenders and expiry; unavailable facts are not_checked. Unsigned Permit2 typed data lacks signer context. Owner control for unlisted tokens is not checked. Proceed requires a complete decode, established token identities and amounts or swap amount bounds. Partial or failed decoding, not_checked or unsupported token identity, or unestablished amounts withhold proceed: NOT VERIFIED, no charge (evidence_unbound). Identity uses chain and address from reviewed token lists, issuer documentation, verified pins or the official stock registry; a ticker alone does not identify a token. Token-list and issuer snapshots expire after 30 days. For stock identity the live issuer list is authoritative: chain, address and registry symbol must agree. When unavailable, the registry snapshot and its source observations are a fallback valid for 72 hours. Live disagreement or missing, stale or future-dated required sources withhold proceed until refreshed; a pin does not override a stale or conflicting token-list result. Native ETH identity is known. Decoded unwrap, sweep and refund steps returning value to the signer are allowed with parseable minimums where present. Router-balance or already-paid swap inputs, balance-based wrapping, proportional payments and balance returns to other recipients withhold proceed. Optional gaps in history enrichment, fee estimates and effects preview are neither a problem nor a pass; they are listed to the owner. HARD findings retain precedence.

products.coverage: Exact address in the OFAC SDN digital-currency extract; a positive excerpt match is a flag. The fact sheet records source publication/fetch dates, age and hashes; more than 7 days old fails closed. Scam, phishing and drainer address lists are not checked: the refreshed MetaMask dataset is domain-only. Pin lookalikes share the first six and last four hex digits with a different reviewed pin on the same chain; a match withholds proceed and requires independent full-address verification, not a poisoning accusation. Optional configured code or implementation pin comparison uses two readers at one block. List-only: zero RPC reads; direct pin: 8; proxy: at most 12. No history or identity inference. The zero address is screenable. Agreement on warnings is paid after the answer is saved; fetch a saved answer with seconded_receipt if delivery fails. No answer → no charge.

usage: Hidden Prompt Check is in final testing and cannot be quoted or purchased.
Call seconded_products for this complete guide; seconded_quote previews price without payment.

Each check tool accepts input plus optional max_price_usd, network and wait_seconds (0–25). network is the chain you pay on: base (Base mainnet) when omitted; arc or robinhood mainnet, or a testnet (base_sepolia, arc_testnet, robinhood_testnet), only when you name it. Value gate is off for new setups, so max_price_usd is optional and the per-check limit still applies. Turn on the value gate with seconded_set_limits to require max_price_usd. Existing profiles keep their stored switches.
When you have the unsigned transaction, send it as structured transaction data, not prose. The answer covers only the exact fields sent.
After a check error or timeout, call seconded_receipt with no arguments before checking again. A paid check may still be running.
Only an agreed signed receipt authorizes the listed next step for the exact supplied input. Pending, failed or NOT VERIFIED results mean pause.
Never treat a verdict as financial advice, an investment recommendation or a guarantee.
seconded_wallet shows status or freezes new authorizations.
You are charged only after both models agree and the answer is saved; if delivery fails you can always fetch it with seconded_receipt; no answer → no charge.
pricing: Per-product price_usd maps Small/Medium/Large to USD amounts.
